anime.description:
On February 29, 2000, a group of Möbius meteorites fell down to earth. These meteorites brought new material called Möbius Dust, which dissolves in air and can cause miracles. The day the Möbius meteorites fell was dubbed 2.29, and the economic disparity in Japan increased dramatically after that day. A group of people fed up with the wealth inequality fought back with acts of terrorism. The police established a special group to fight against the terrorists and a school to train members for that group.

(Sources: Comic Natalie, Live Chart)

descriptions.default:
On February 29, 2000, a group of Möbius meteorites fell down to earth. These meteorites brought new material called Möbius Dust, which dissolves in air and can cause miracles. The day the Möbius meteorites fell was dubbed 2.29, and the economic disparity in Japan increased dramatically after that day. A group of people fed up with the wealth inequality fought back with acts of terrorism. The police established a special group to fight against the terrorists and a school to train members for that group.

(Sources: Comic Natalie, Live Chart)

anime.description:
“ANIMATION × PARALYMPIC: Who Is Your Hero?” is a special series featuring fictional Paralympic athletes depicted in world-renowned Japanese animation. The project aims to introduce new Paralympic sports heroes through attractive characters and stories that will be created by the collaboration of famous comic creators and animation film directors. The series will increase the number of featured sports by 2020.

An episode animated by Kyoto Animation was scheduled to be broadcast in August 2019, but was later announced to be cancelled after it was determined production could not be completed in time for the 2020 Paralympic Games due to a tragic arson attack on the studio.

descriptions.default:
“ANIMATION × PARALYMPIC: Who Is Your Hero?” is a special series featuring fictional Paralympic athletes depicted in world-renowned Japanese animation. The project aims to introduce new Paralympic sports heroes through attractive characters and stories that will be created by the collaboration of famous comic creators and animation film directors. The series will increase the number of featured sports by 2020.

An episode animated by Kyoto Animation was scheduled to be broadcast in August 2019, but was later announced to be cancelled after it was determined production could not be completed in time for the 2020 Paralympic Games due to a tragic arson attack on the studio.

Episode 1 & 2 - Ore ga Mita Koto no Nai Kanojo
A couple in love, thinking about marriage, have a tough decision ahead of them. They might have to move in with Tomoya's father. However that isn't even the start of the problem, upon showing up at his father's house, Kanako realizes that not only does she know his father... but she has slept with him... multiple times.

Episode 3 - Delivery Sex
All she wanted was for her son to help her move... but apparently he had "club activities". So he enlisted the help of one of his seniors who works for a moving company. Unfortunately however, she doesn't have any money... so the only way to pay...

Episode 4 - JK Bitch no Renai Soudan
The biggest slut of the class just had to show up when I was trying to get my thoughts together, and while I was dealing with such embarrassing stuff as well!

Episode 5 - JK Mama no Shikentaisaku
Kawai is likely to fail her final exams, so at Fujimaki's suggestion, she invites him over to her house to help her study. However, Kawai prefers to spend more time on sex activities than studying. Ayako, Kawai's mother, wants her daughter to study hard so she proposed Fujimaki to have his time for sex with her instead.

Episode 6 - Oyako no Omoi
Her son comes home after being bullied, but she had to hear this from one of his classmates... what can she possibly do?

Episode 7 - Yukino-sensei no Seikyouiku

Note: Episode 7 is in production.

Episode 1 & 2 - Ore ga Mita Koto no Nai Kanojo
A couple in love, thinking about marriage, have a tough decision ahead of them. They might have to move in with Tomoya's father. However that isn't even the start of the problem, upon showing up at his father's house, Kanako realizes that not only does she know his father... but she has slept with him... multiple times.

Episode 3 - Delivery Sex
All she wanted was for her son to help her move... but apparently he had "club activities". So he enlisted the help of one of his seniors who works for a moving company. Unfortunately however, she doesn't have any money... so the only way to pay...

Episode 4 - JK Bitch no Renai Soudan
The biggest slut of the class just had to show up when I was trying to get my thoughts together, and while I was dealing with such embarrassing stuff as well!

Episode 5 - JK Mama no Shikentaisaku
Kawai is likely to fail her final exams, so at Fujimaki's suggestion, she invites him over to her house to help her study. However, Kawai prefers to spend more time on sex activities than studying. Ayako, Kawai's mother, wants her daughter to study hard so she proposed Fujimaki to have his time for sex with her instead.

Episode 6 - Oyako no Omoi
Her son comes home after being bullied, but she had to hear this from one of his classmates... what can she possibly do?

Episode 7 - Yukino-sensei no Seikyouiku

Note: Episode 7 is in production.

anime.description: Koyan, the Origami Ninja, came to Earth from his planet Origamio to find the magical stone "Hapiton" that has the ability to make people happy. On the way, he was joined by childhood friend Namin anda new friend Lublin. One day, a villain called Evilrun appeared. Evilrun has a black hole in her stomach and tries to inhale anything. Every time an event happens, Evilrun gets in the way of Koyan and friends. But what Evilrun's aim is remains a mystery...

descriptions.default:
From unraveling the secrets of opening and closing doors to defusing surprise packages more commonly known as bombs, there is never a dull day at the Hololive Production office! Holo no Graffiti follows an eccentric cast of Virtual YouTubers, also known as "VTubers," going about their absurd yet hilarious daily lives, detailing all their cute moments and mishaps.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

anime.description:
Assorted commercials for the Azur Lane Mobile Game posted on the official Youtube channel. The animation is unique to these commercials and is not present in the game nor in the TV Series.

The list of the commercials is as follows (note that CMs without animation are not present and, for the ones with long and short versions, the longer version is taken into consideration):

1) 縹映る深緋の残響篇 (17 April 2020)
2) 神穹を衝く聖歌 (19 May 2020)
3) 極夜照らす幻光 (23 July 2020)

Amemiya's [animation and directing](https://blog.sakugabooru.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/mini-imaishi.mp4) is very similar to Imaishi's yet is less chaotic and contains more 'retro' devices like impact frames and multi-tonal shading, drawing a lot of inspiration from [Masami Obari](https://anilist.co/staff/100660/Masami-Obari). For these reasons he was frequently typecasted for old school pose-heavy mecha combat. Amemiya is a nerdy director whose anime often heavily references other series and artists he loves, sometimes even replicating Obari's [animation sequences](https://blog.sakugabooru.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/dangaioh2.mp4) and [layouts](https://i.imgur.com/nTRdM4K.jpg), [Transformer](https://twitter.com/SSS_SGRID/status/1051063114022572033)'s color designs, and Hideaki Anno's [establishing shots](https://blog.sakugabooru.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/welcome-to-the-anno-class.jpg) as well as long-lingering framing. Amemiya called Anno's [Neon Genesis Evangelion](https://anilist.co/anime/30/Evangelion/) his [favorite series before](https://i.imgur.com/nEYK186.png). Between his ode-heavy artistry he interjects personality with [subtle details](https://blog.sakugabooru.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/what-kind-of-brand-is-TOMATO-LIFE-tho.jpg), visual gags, and repurposing tonally contrasting homages into a different context. Amemiya graduated from Tokyo University of Technology and was part of the university's anime research society. During his time there he became heavily influenced by Osaka University's anime research club [Group CAS](https://twitter.com/group_cas). At the time [Toshiyuki Satou](https://anilist.co/staff/107357/Toshiyuki-Satou) was part of the group, while [Ikehata Hiroshi](https://anilist.co/staff/120505/Ikehata-Hiroshi) visited regularly. After a bit of indie work Amemiya joined studio Gainax and climbed up the hierarchy: from clean-up to animation direction, onto storyboarding and episode directing, until after joining studio Trigger and co-directing Kill la Kill finally having the credentials to debut with his own series. He is married to animator [Megumi Kouno](https://anilist.co/staff/120602/Megumi-Kouno). anime.description:
Mitsuki Aya has one goal at the elite Kuromi Girls’ Academy: to become a refined young lady like the school’s flawless “White Lily,” Yorue Mio. Twitter | Instagram | YouTube__ Introduction: Halca is a Japanese musician affiliated with company Music Ray'n and signed to label Sacra Music. She had a major appearance as the opening act during the CHiCO with HoneyWorks 2017 tour. In 2018 she released her first single called "Kimi no Tonari", which was used as the ending theme for the anime "Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku". Her other appearances have been in anime such as: Ace Attorney, Kaguya-sama: Love is War and We Never Learn!: BOKUBEN Season 2 Biography: Halca started with an interest in music from early childhood. She was heavily inspired when she one day received a copy of the song "Again" by YUI. While in junior high school, she discovered that her home's cable TV had an anime channel, which is also the way she became familiar with anime music in general. She would watch this anime channel on a daily basis, which slowly began to impact her future plans. The biggest impact from the several anime shows she watched in her childhood, were shows such as Cardcaptor Sakura and Toradora!. The anime that had the biggest musical influence ended up being the song "Kiss Kara Hajimaru Miracle" from the anime Steel Angel Kurumi, which became her favorite anime song. She decided to join her school's choir club and broadcast theater club later on to hone her vocal skills, as she started to take an approach to singing herself. After honing her skills in school she officially decided to pursue a career as a musician. Halca had a lot of singing auditions to consider, but the audition that piqued her interest the most was for the Utakatsu! Audition, which focused on anime songs. She decided to participate in the audition for Utakatsu!, and she ended up winning the grand prize in 2013. She didn't let win go to her head, however, as after the winning the audition she continued to train her vocal skills while waiting to make her major debut. In 2017 she was invited by the singer CHiCO, known primarily for her involvement in the group HoneyWorks (alongside Gom, Shito and Yamako), to perform in the latter's 2017 live tour as their opening act. Following her opening act, she performed the song "Kimi no Sora" ("Your Sky"), which was included in a compilation album released to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the online novel publisher Noichigo. She also performed with the song "Resonator", which was used in the original soundtrack for the anime series "Beatless", and she also made a mini-album titled White Disc, which was sold during the HoneyWorks tour. Halca made her major debut later in 2018, with the release of her first single "Kimi no Tonari" ("Next to You"), which was used as the ending theme for the anime Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku. To commemorate the release of her first single, the mini-album White Disc was made available for sale during the single's release event. Her second single "Starting Blue" was released in October 2018, with the title track being used as the ending theme for the second season of the anime Ace Attorney. Her third single "Sentimental Crisis" was released in February 2019, the title track was used as the ending theme for the anime Kaguya-sama: Love is War. Her fourth single "Houkago no Liberty" was released on November 13, 2019, the title track was used as the ending theme to the anime We Never Learn!: BOKUBEN Season 2. descriptions.default:
Mitsuki Aya has one goal at the elite Kuromi Girls’ Academy: to become a refined young lady like the school’s flawless “White Lily,” Yorue Mio. But her image of Mio shatters when Aya accidentally catches her...playing fighting games?! Turns out, the elegant Mio is actually a hardcore gamer—and she wants to duel Aya! The battle (and their friendship) begins.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
Some gyarus have decided to use Imaizumi's house as a gathering spot to play video games and eat snacks. When Reina gets bored with video games, she sets her sights on another toy in the house: Imaizumi himself...

(Source: Fakku!)

anime.description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

descriptions.default: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

anime.description:
It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid of the ants behind it. He firmly believed in human beings and entered the path of cultivation with mediocre qualifications. After experiencing ups and downs, with his wise mind, he gradually reached the pinnacle and became famous in the cultivation world with his own strength.

(Source: WeTV)

descriptions.default:
It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid of the ants behind it. He firmly believed in human beings and entered the path of cultivation with mediocre qualifications. After experiencing ups and downs, with his wise mind, he gradually reached the pinnacle and became famous in the cultivation world with his own strength.

(Source: WeTV)

anime.title_english: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan
anime.description:
The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?
</br></br>
(Source: WeTV)

titles.english: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan

descriptions.default:
The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?
</br></br>
(Source: WeTV)

Animated promotional videos for the smartphone game Blue Archive.

1) アニメPV フルVer. (25 January 2021)
2) 便利屋68 (11 May 2021)
3) トリニティの夏、ゲヘナの夏。 (24 July 2021)

5) 1st Anniversary Animation PV (25 November 2022)

9) 陽ひらく彼女たちの小夜曲 (21 January 2024)

11) Say-Bing! (23 June 2024)

13) Serenade Promenade (20 October 2024)
14) ハイランダー鉄道爆走事件 ～そして列車はなくなった～ (20 April 2025)
15) ブルーアーカイブ「6th PV」(20 April 2025)
16) 百ヨリ出ズル一輪ノ 〜いざ尋常に、水上勝負〜 (21 June 2025)
17) 夏空のやくそく (19 July 2025)
18) 魔法少女ヘヴィキャリバー～エラの野望と正義の資格～ (18 October 2025)

23) 嵐過天晴 (20 June 2026)
24) 出航！万魔船　マコト議長の華麗なる避暑 (26 July 2026)

anime.description:
The sometimes happy, sometimes sad, and a tad stressful daily life of "some sort of small, cute creature" known as Chiikawa. Chiikawa enjoys delicious food with bees and rabbits, toils hard every day for the rewards of work, and still maintains a smile.

(Source: Anime News Network)

prominent in the soundtracks for anime, video game, and tokusatsu productions. He is sometimes called Kami by his fans. Kageyama got his big break at age 16, as lead singer of the pop group LAZY. By the early '80s, the band split and Kageyama went solo. He found major success once he started to sing the theme songs of anime and tokusatsu shows. Becoming immensely popular soon after, Kageyama went on to be dubbed the "Prince of Anime/Tokusatsu Songs" and is a main fixture for shows to this day. anime.description:
The year is 20XX. The ninja, who once forged the history of Japan, were scattered across the country during the Meiji Restoration. As these ninja mingled with the other clans, their bloodline thinned, and they gradually faded from sight. The descendants of these ninja clans, seeking to preserve their heritage, formed the WNA (World Ninja Association) in the hope of carrying on their legacy.

And so it was that the WNA succeeded in developing Ninja-Gum, an art which could summon forth the strength of the Shinobi. And yet creating the most powerful Ninja-Gum requires the strongest of ninja DNA. So it was that the Ninjala Tournament was held, that the mightiest of all ninjas could be found...

(Source: Official Game website)

descriptions.default:
The year is 20XX. The ninja, who once forged the history of Japan, were scattered across the country during the Meiji Restoration. As these ninja mingled with the other clans, their bloodline thinned, and they gradually faded from sight. The descendants of these ninja clans, seeking to preserve their heritage, formed the WNA (World Ninja Association) in the hope of carrying on their legacy.

And so it was that the WNA succeeded in developing Ninja-Gum, an art which could summon forth the strength of the Shinobi. And yet creating the most powerful Ninja-Gum requires the strongest of ninja DNA. So it was that the Ninjala Tournament was held, that the mightiest of all ninjas could be found...

(Source: Official Game website)

From early 1981 until 1986, Sugimori illustrated a gaming fanzine called Game Freak, which had been started by Satoshi Tajiri. Sugimori discovered the magazine in a doujinshi shop, and decided to get involved. Eventually, the two decided to pitch an arcade game design idea to Namco; they reworked Game Freak into a development company and produced Mendel Palace. \n\nSugimori is most famous as the character designer and art director for the Pokémon franchise. For Pokémon Black and White, Sugimori directed a team of 17 people in designing new characters for the games, though he always drew the final designs. (Spoiler-free)", "rating": 12, "userRating": "NO_VOTE", "score": 100, "body": "Hi there,\n\n> This is a repost of the original review I made for Pokémon Horizons a year ago. I left Anilist last April and came back a few days ago with a new account.\nThis review will talk about episodes 001 to 089.\n\nIf you know me at all, you know that I'm an absolute Pokémon fan. This obviously includes the games, but beyond that, it includes the entire Pokémon universe.\n\nThis universe includes games, manga, plush toys, games, cards, LEGO (soon) and the Pokémon anime. For over 25 years, this anime was known for “Ash from Palette Town”, “The Team Rocket” and Pikachu, until early 2023, when The Pokémon Company announced the end of the Ash-era and a new series with a new protagonist and a new story: Pokémon Horizons.\n\n~~~img(https://media1.tenor.com/m/K6A6dq7nmykAAAAd/pokemon-horizons-liko.gif)~~~\n\nWith the end of what I call the first real season of Pokémon Horizon, I figured it was time to do my very first anime review there and tell you why Pokémon Horizons is part of my life.\n\n<br />\n\n~~~\n# Context~~~\n\nIt's April 13, 2023, and the next day the first episodes of the new Pokémon series, Pokémon Horizons, will be released in Japan. At the time, I was actively following Pokémon Journeys in French, the last arc of the Ash era, and I was already in a mood where Pokémon Journeys made me evolve enormously and really immersed me in anime for good (I hardly followed any at the time, it was very occasional or even non-existent, depending on the year).\n\nFor Pokémon Horizons, I decided to watch the series in OV and not in VF (\"Version Française\" - French version), to avoid the frustration of having to wait months or even a year for the anime to catch up with the Japanese version. When Horizons came out, we'd just started the final tournament of the Galar League, which lasted a good ten episodes (just to let you know that we still had a long way to go).\n\nI was very skeptical when Pokémon Horizons arrived, because for me, Ash was the very essence of what Pokémon anime was, having grown up watching the anime over the years of my childhood whether on TV or DVD. (The only season I didn't see at all was the Sun and Moon arc).\n\n<br />\n~~~\n# A very effective start\n~~~\n\nThe first episodes are released and... it's already a monumental slap in the face. In 48 minutes (the first 2 episodes were broadcast together as one big block), Horizons gave me a huge slap in the face to Ash's 25-year career. I have to say that between the 5485151st attempt by Team Rocket to capture Pikachu and what happens in these episodes, one of the two scenarios is much more mature and enjoyable to watch.\n\nWhat's more, this is one of the few times that a Pokémon has been incorporated into the anime before the main games in the series, and not just any Pokémon either, as it's a Pokémon that will be central to this “season 1” that I've named: Terapagos.\n\n~~~img(https://media1.tenor.com/m/hV_-3CiMVhIAAAAC/terapagos-pagogo.gif)~~~\n\nIn the original version, this “season 1” is divided into 4 arcs:\n\n- *Liko and Roy's departure* (Episode 01 to 25)\n- *The Sparkling of Terapagos* (Episode 26 to 45)\n- *Terastal Debut* (Episode 46 to 67)\n- *Rayquaza Rising* (Episode 68 to 89)\n\nIn the U.S. and European versions, each season comprises 2 arcs (for the time being), with season 1 including episodes 01 to 45 and season 2 from 46 to 89.\n\nEach arc follows a different storyline while retaining a common objective, and compared to the Ash era where the objective was just to become the master, you could watch an episode on the fly without having seen any previous episode and still be totally lost, The narration of Pokémon Horizons puts a MONUMENTAL slap in the face of 25 years of anime with Sacha, because the episodes really do follow one another linearly, and it's not microadventures that advance the story, as was the case with *Journeys* for example, but a whole adventure that you follow from start to finish.\n\n<br />\n~~~\n# Unique and endearing characters\n~~~\n\nThere are 4 main characters in this series: **Liko, Friede, Roy and Dot** (as well as their partner Pokémon **Cap'** (Pikachu) and the trio of 9th-generation starters).\n\nNarratively, the one who “replaces” Ash's role is Liko, who will form a trio with Roy and Dot over the course of her adventure. As for Friede, he'll let you explain what he is in the series, if he doesn't forget. I'll focus on the trio in this section.\n\n\n~~~\n<br />\n## Roy: The one who we love to trash talk\nimg(https://diamant.ink/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/pokemon-horizons-roy-pokemon.gif)\n~~~\n\nLet's start with Roy, because it's going to be pretty short. Roy is a very energetic character who thinks of only one thing: **fighting.** In the adventure, his goal is to capture a specific, powerful Pokémon and therefore be strong enough to train. He's a bit of an airhead, relies a lot on strength and little on strategy, and loves to sing.\n\nExcept that relying on his strength and not his strategy makes him a bit of a hothead, and even the writers have to play up to that because compared to Liko and Dot, right now even after 89 episodes, we know very little of Roy's backstory. I'm hopeful that one day we'll get a real Roy backstory, but until then, I and some other people who follow the series closely here love trashtalking him, even if we do like him a little (but shush.)\n\n~~~\n<br />\n## Liko: An adventuress despite herself\nimg(https://diamant.ink/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/sprigatito-liko.gif)\n~~~\n\nAs mentioned above, Liko is Ash's “replacement”, and it's with her that we begin and follow the adventure from episode to episode. Originally from Paldea, she's a character who evolves over the course of the series: at first, she's a character who's lost in her thoughts, her emotions and who has no confidence in herself. Then, as the adventure progresses, she becomes a person who gains confidence in herself and in her friends and her Pokémon, and who manages to lose herself a lot less. (I won't say too much to avoid spoiling the series).\n\nHer goal in the adventure is at first to live a student life abroad, but this is quickly compromised right in episode 1, when she has to protect something very sentimental to her.\n\nAt first glance, she doesn't have much of a backstory like Roy, but Liko is the character who evolves and matures the most over the course of the adventure. However, it would be a lie to proclaim that Liko has no backstory, being the main character and Ash's replacement, she is the central character of this adventure and as time goes by, we learn that she is much more involved than we could have imagined and we finally learn that she has a huge story around her.\n\n~~~\n<br />\n## Dot: My beloved\nimg(https://media1.tenor.com/m/0ll0oyUN6BkAAAAC/quaxly-pokemon.gif)\n~~~\n\nThe one I'm most fond of in the end. Dot is a very introverted and shy character, but she's also strategic and competent. In the trio, she's the one with the most backstory, with a few episodes dedicated to her and her past.\n\nShe doesn't appear at the start of the series (although...), so it's a good dozen episodes before we get to see her little by little, until she joins the duo of Liko and Roy and the duo becomes a trio.\n\nHer goal in this adventure is to open up to the world, and to protect those she holds dear to her heart.\n\nI could really write a novel about why I adore Dot more than any character in this series or even in the Pokémon universe, but this is a review of Pokémon Horizons, not of the character Dot herself (and that would be spoilerfree).\n\nBut to make a long story short, I recognize a lot more of myself in her than anyone would imagine. If you know me at all, you know how passionate I am about this character.\n\n<br />\n\n~~~\n# <a>Pokémon horizons: my favorite safe place</a>\n~~~\n\nIt's been 2 years now, this April 14th, that every night from Friday to Saturday, I've been watching the episodes (with English subtitles) before going to sleep. At first, I was just watching, but after the 3rd arc, I started to share my impressions of the series here, [on the forums](https://anilist.co/forum/recent?media=158871), which few people were doing before by posting threads on each episode from episode 48 onwards, and which I'm still doing today.\n\nMore than just another Pokémon series, Horizons is, for me, a new formula in Pokémon anime that works and completely overturns 25 years of Ash anime. The story is so much better developed and imposing, enormously more mature and serious, the anime's artstyle is in step with the times and you can feel that they wanted to go in a new direction at the risk of losing fans by breaking everything. But it's successful, very successful.\n\nThe anime isn't perfect, and there are a few gray areas, such as the lack of Roy's story, or the absence of the secondary Pokémons that the trio obtain along the way, including one in particular that obviously comes from Roy.\n\nBut as far as I'm concerned, Pokémon Horizons has done so much for me personally, made me feel so many emotions, joys, tears and discoveries, that I can't give it anything other than a 10/10.\n\nRemember when I mentioned Liko, the fact that she evolves enormously in the series? Well, I'm like Liko, totally, in two years I've evolved enormously with Horizons. I've made some sublime friends by opening up to others and investing a lot of time in the Horizons community here on anilist, and every episode has been a breath of happiness and a cure for any sadness I may have. It's a real appointment that I cherish above everything else in this world.\n\nAnd I'm limiting myself a lot to avoid saying too much and spoiling certain moments (it's very hard, especially not to talk about Dot), but each episode really is my little safe place, a little hour of pure happiness in which I forget that the world exists and put myself in a bubble that I cherish so much. A bubble I'm happy and proud to be in. A bubble that takes me away from all the worries of the world, all my negative thoughts, all my fears, all my worries, and which just, for the time of an episode and a post on a forum, makes me dream.\n\nimg(https://media1.tenor.com/m/idk0Nwo-b68AAAAC/pokemon-horizons-pokemon-dance.gif)", "createdAt": 1786654005, "updatedAt": 1788980569, "siteUrl": "https://anilist.co/review/32689", "user": {"id": 8196049, "name": "Adiamantine", "avatar": {"large": "https://s4.anilist.co/file/anilistcdn/user/avatar/large/b8196049-WRdvoPMHxEJ8.png", "medium": "https://s4.anilist.co/file/anilistcdn/user/avatar/medium/b8196049-WRdvoPMHxEJ8.png"}, "siteUrl": "https://anilist.co/user/8196049"}}}], "pageInfo": {"total": 1, "perPage": 10, "currentPage": 1, "lastPage": 1, "hasNextPage": false}}, "stats": {"scoreDistribution": [{"score": 10, "amount": 51}, {"score": 20, "amount": 31}, {"score": 30, "amount": 61}, {"score": 40, "amount": 91}, {"score": 50, "amount": 253}, {"score": 60, "amount": 433}, {"score": 70, "amount": 951}, {"score": 80, "amount": 961}, {"score": 90, "amount": 687}, {"score": 100, "amount": 485}], "statusDistribution": [{"status": "CURRENT", "amount": 10809}, {"status": "PLANNING", "amount": 7217}, {"status": "COMPLETED", "amount": 673}, {"status": "DROPPED", "amount": 2271}, {"status": "PAUSED", "amount": 3442}]}, "siteUrl": "https://anilist.co/anime/158871", "autoCreateForumThread": false, "isRecommendationBlocked": false, "isReviewBlocked": false, "modNotes": null}

Fairouz was born to a Japanese mother and an Egyptian father. She was named after the Lebanese singer, Fairuz. She spent a few years of her elementary education in Cairo before returning to Japan. During her junior high school years, she became familiar with the manga series [JoJo's Bizarre Adventure](https://anilist.co/manga/31517/). Due to her growing interest in the series, she would join Skype reading sessions with other fans. Eventually, she was inspired to pursue a career in voice acting, but her parents initially disapproved of her plans. Instead, she would initially study at a graphic design vocational school before spending a year as a dental assistant. Once she was able to save enough money for tuition, she enrolled in a voice acting training school. In 2019, she debuted as [Hibiki Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/132856/), the protagonist of the anime series [How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift?](https://anilist.co/anime/107226/) In a Twitter post on 31st December 2024 she announced her indefinite hiatus from voice acting due to health complications surrounding PTSD. titles.native: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です2
titles.romaji: Otomege Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu 2

descriptions.default:
Office worker Leon has just been thrust into an otome game where women hold all the power. His only tool for survival is the knowledge gained from playing this game in his past life. But after befriending the heroine and villainess, and making a name for himself, his choices begin to warp the story beyond what he knows. Now, Leon is dragged into a conspiracy that could shake the entire kingdom.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anime.description:
To celebrate "Cheese Day," (November 11 in Japan), Cartoon Network Japan debuted an anime spin on Tom and Jerry that combines the fast-paced humor of the original with a cute, "pop" worldview. The pair are joined by the diaper-wearing Tuffy Mouse, another recurring character from the classic cartoon.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
To celebrate "Cheese Day," (November 11 in Japan), Cartoon Network Japan debuted an anime spin on Tom and Jerry that combines the fast-paced humor of the original with a cute, "pop" worldview. The pair are joined by the diaper-wearing Tuffy Mouse, another recurring character from the classic cartoon.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
Misaki Akane, a high school girl who live by herself because her parents are too busy with their job, rented a room just to find there's a mistake on the contract and force her to live with Hazama Ken, a salaryman, until another room is vacant.

Unbeknownst to them, the mistake is a start of such an unexpected romance in their lives...

anime.description: One hundred thousand years ago, he was the founding disciple of the Tianlan Sect, his master ascended to the top, and he was refining Qi. Ninety thousand years ago, his martial nephew ascended, and he was refining Qi. Fifty thousand years ago, the old dog who was the gatekeeper of Tianlanzong also ascended, and he was still refining Qi. Thirty thousand years ago, the old tree at the foot of the mountain also became a demon, and he was still refining Qi before he could pass the catastrophe. Ten thousand years ago, Zhang Wuji, the 9872nd generation disciple of Tianlanzong, also ascended, and Xu Yang silently refined Qi. He retreated for 10,000 years, and finally, he broke through the 9999th floor of the Qi refining period! Ten thousand years later, he broke through and came out!
anime.synonyms: ["One Hundred Thousand Years of Qi Refining", "Lian Qi 100 Nian", "ข้าก็แค่ฝึกวิชาหนึ่งแสนปี"]

descriptions.default: One hundred thousand years ago, he was the founding disciple of the Tianlan Sect, his master ascended to the top, and he was refining Qi. Ninety thousand years ago, his martial nephew ascended, and he was refining Qi. Fifty thousand years ago, the old dog who was the gatekeeper of Tianlanzong also ascended, and he was still refining Qi. Thirty thousand years ago, the old tree at the foot of the mountain also became a demon, and he was still refining Qi before he could pass the catastrophe. Ten thousand years ago, Zhang Wuji, the 9872nd generation disciple of Tianlanzong, also ascended, and Xu Yang silently refined Qi. He retreated for 10,000 years, and finally, he broke through the 9999th floor of the Qi refining period! Ten thousand years later, he broke through and came out!

anime.description:
In the game, the server's top swordsman, Xiao Wujin, and the most wanted female outlaw, Tao Zhiyaoyao, first crossed paths as rivals. In real life, campus heartthrob Xiao He of Dongchuan University and freshman Shen Xin met through a collegiate esports tournament and quickly grew close. Together with their friend Yang Yao, they formed a team and fought their way through every challenge, determined to claim the championship. Along the way, Xiao He and Shen Xin healed and inspired one another, moving forward hand in hand in pursuit of their dreams. With a little help from their friends Yang Yao and Xiang Nan, what kind of romance will blossom between them?

(Source: iQ)

Episode 1

Owner's Wife
The newlyweds had found a new house and went to greet their landlord, only to find that Murai, a former volleyball coach, had taken over the family business. Marin Momodate (maiden name) had bitter memories of Murai from her school days, and just as she was trying to avoid him as much as possible, she found him when she returned home after leaving the company on a long career break. Masashi, her husband, was put to sleep and the space was now just the two of them. The coach and she were sexfriends, and he rubs her tits as if it were a matter of course. Marin tries to refuse, but the past comes back to her, and she can't forget Murai's stubby, middle-aged body. Marin becomes addicted to each of his techniques, and her feelings gradually shift to becoming Murai's female toilet.

Mama to Tanetsuke no Su
A mother continues to seduce her son, Yuri, with tongue kisses every day. When they were running out of patience with the excessive skinship, Hiroki, a friend of Yuri, came to visit them. Her husband is away on a long business trip, and the mother, frustrated, masturbates in her room. Hiroki happened to catch her in the act, and he threatened her to tell Yuri about it. It's a mother who allowed everything to Hiroki as she was told.

Episode 2

anime.description:
To the empire, Prince Arnold is one big joke, a completely inept prince outshone by his more talented twin, Leonard. But in secret, Arnold operates as Silver, one of only five magic-wielding SS-rank adventurers on the continent. As the bloody battle for the throne intensifies after the crown prince’s death, Arnold pulls the strings from the shadows to crown his twin emperor to his own advantage.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
To the empire, Prince Arnold is one big joke, a completely inept prince outshone by his more talented twin, Leonard. But in secret, Arnold operates as Silver, one of only five magic-wielding SS-rank adventurers on the continent. As the bloody battle for the throne intensifies after the crown prince’s death, Arnold pulls the strings from the shadows to crown his twin emperor to his own advantage.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anime.title_user_preferred: Tenkousaki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi datta Ken
anime.description:
Seven years after making a childhood promise to always be friends, Hayato is reunited with his formerly tomboyish pal Haruki at a city high school–only now, Haruki has transformed into the girl every guy dreams about! While Haruki’s looks may have changed, with Hayato, she’s still the same pal he remembers. Despite years apart, their promise and feelings remain and deepen into something stronger.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

titles.romaji: Tenkousaki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi datta Ken

descriptions.default:
Seven years after making a childhood promise to always be friends, Hayato is reunited with his formerly tomboyish pal Haruki at a city high school–only now, Haruki has transformed into the girl every guy dreams about! While Haruki’s looks may have changed, with Hayato, she’s still the same pal he remembers. Despite years apart, their promise and feelings remain and deepen into something stronger.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anime.title_english: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke
anime.title_native: 本好きの下剋上 領主の養女
anime.title_user_preferred: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Ryoushu no Youjo
anime.description:
Following a disastrous encounter with a noble, Myne finally resolves to say goodbye to her family and friends in the lower city, changing her name to “Rozemyne” and beginning her new life as the adopted daughter of Ehrenfest’s archduke. However, her days as an archnoble in noble society are brutal, as she is put through rigorous etiquette and magic training on top of her duties as High Bishop and forewoman. It all proves too much for a weak little seven-year-old girl... Or it would have, had the High Priest not offered her the keys to the temple’s book room as a reward. If she could get her hands on those, she’d be able to read all sorts of precious books! Her name may have changed, but Rozemyne’s passion for books remains the same as she charges into a whole new world! The detailed setting expands as the printing industry grows in size. Here begins Part 3 of this biblio-fantasy for book lovers everywhere!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Rozemyne is an archnoble girl. Her flowing midnight-blue hair is well kept, silkier than even the hair of most archnoble girls, and her moon-like golden-yellow eyes are like windows into her emotional heart. She has a pretty face as well, and would no doubt grow up to be a true beauty. She has pale white skin largely untouched by the sun, and soft hands that weren't at all worn down by labor. Rozemyne ​​has a massive amount of mana inside her. Her mana is so great that Karstedt determined that it was necessary to hide his own daughter and raise her in secret, away from any danger. [The former High Bishop](https://anilist.co/character/126545) misunderstood her presence in the temple, and not discerning her true identity, he began to groan and complain that a commoner shrine maiden disturbed the peace. Rozemyne ​​was raised humbly, unaware of her parents or their status, but still, her compassionate heart ached for the suffering of those who lived in worse circumstances than her. She felt sorry for the children who lived in the orphanage, and did what no one else would by giving them food and work, due to that, Rozemyne is worshiped and honored by the orphans as a Saint. [The Archduke](https://anilist.co/character/157135) determined that the work Rozemyne gave to the orphans could become a new industry for his duchy. Just when he was considering spending the next twenty or more years spreading it around the duchy, Rozemyne ​​was targeted by [a noble from another duchy](https://anilist.co/character/157148). titles.romaji: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Ryoushu no Youjo

descriptions.default:
Following a disastrous encounter with a noble, Myne finally resolves to say goodbye to her family and friends in the lower city, changing her name to “Rozemyne” and beginning her new life as the adopted daughter of Ehrenfest’s archduke. However, her days as an archnoble in noble society are brutal, as she is put through rigorous etiquette and magic training on top of her duties as High Bishop and forewoman. It all proves too much for a weak little seven-year-old girl... Or it would have, had the High Priest not offered her the keys to the temple’s book room as a reward. If she could get her hands on those, she’d be able to read all sorts of precious books! Her name may have changed, but Rozemyne’s passion for books remains the same as she charges into a whole new world! The detailed setting expands as the printing industry grows in size. Here begins Part 3 of this biblio-fantasy for book lovers everywhere!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

anime.description:
Manaka is in love with the handsome teacher Tonami, whom she admires, and Mizuki gently watches over her younger sister. The sisters thought that their sweet and bitter youth would continue like this, but...? When Manaka confesses to Tonami that she will do anything for him and wants to go out with him, everything changes! In exchange for going out with him, Manaka is at Tonami's mercy, and one day she is surrounded by strange men who are Tonami's "friends". The men who surround the frightened Manaka make her immerse herself in hellish pleasure...?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

descriptions.default:
Manaka is in love with the handsome teacher Tonami, whom she admires, and Mizuki gently watches over her younger sister. The sisters thought that their sweet and bitter youth would continue like this, but...? When Manaka confesses to Tonami that she will do anything for him and wants to go out with him, everything changes! In exchange for going out with him, Manaka is at Tonami's mercy, and one day she is surrounded by strange men who are Tonami's "friends". The men who surround the frightened Manaka make her immerse herself in hellish pleasure...?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

anime.description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by capture1.

Yuina is in love with her blood brother. One day, a mysterious voice leads her to a strange place. She is attacked by a man without knowing why, and she is in desperate need of help. But then, a ghostly succubus appears with a light and saves her! The succubus possesses Yuina's body and starts to attack her sexually. The mysterious succubus, who is not bothered by the flustered, naive Yuina, squeezes every man she can get her hands on. What will happen to Yuina in the world of succubus? I want to go home...... to my brother...... I wanted to "connect" with my beloved brother! I've been "connected" to a lecherous succubus! But this is just the way it is.......

(Source: Getchu, translated)

anime.description:
Episode 1 - 2: Sex ga Suki de Suki de Daisuki na Classmate no Anoko
Taichi Sano is short of money and, lured by the high hourly wage, applies for a part-time job as a camera assistant. While he is waiting at the location specified by the employer, his classmate Kanna Hiiragi appears. Kanna has a reputation of being the cutest girl in the school, and many boys confessed their feelings for her. Taichi also harbors a faint hope of dating her, so he hopes that this part-time job will be an opportunity to become closer to her. However, when Taichi finds out that the filming will be for an adult video, he tries to refuse, but Kanna accepts, saying that it will help her learn social studies. Taichi feels happy working part-time with Kanna. The part-time job is going well, although he is nervous about Kanna's occasional bold behavior. However, an accident occurs with the cameraman and actor, and Taichi has to suddenly take over. Kanna ends up doing the filming instead.

Episode 3 - 4: Hitori Ecchi:Onanie x2
Nitta is in love with Natsuki Amamori, who sits next to him. However, Natsuki is an honor student and Nitta is not good at studying, so there is no way they can be a match for each other, and she is a girl beyond his reach. What's more, Nitta has a hobby that he can't tell anyone about. He masturbates on Natsuki wherever he goes, even on school grounds. As he was thinking about Natsuki again today, he heard a noise. He peeked in that direction and found Natsuki masturbating. Nitta was transfixed by her. By chance, Natsuki found him. Seeing that she was about to cry after being seen in an embarrassing situation, Nitta confessed that he had been masturbating just a moment ago.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

descriptions.default:
Episode 1 - 2: Sex ga Suki de Suki de Daisuki na Classmate no Anoko
Taichi Sano is short of money and, lured by the high hourly wage, applies for a part-time job as a camera assistant. While he is waiting at the location specified by the employer, his classmate Kanna Hiiragi appears. Kanna has a reputation of being the cutest girl in the school, and many boys confessed their feelings for her. Taichi also harbors a faint hope of dating her, so he hopes that this part-time job will be an opportunity to become closer to her. However, when Taichi finds out that the filming will be for an adult video, he tries to refuse, but Kanna accepts, saying that it will help her learn social studies. Taichi feels happy working part-time with Kanna. The part-time job is going well, although he is nervous about Kanna's occasional bold behavior. However, an accident occurs with the cameraman and actor, and Taichi has to suddenly take over. Kanna ends up doing the filming instead.

Episode 3 - 4: Hitori Ecchi:Onanie x2
Nitta is in love with Natsuki Amamori, who sits next to him. However, Natsuki is an honor student and Nitta is not good at studying, so there is no way they can be a match for each other, and she is a girl beyond his reach. What's more, Nitta has a hobby that he can't tell anyone about. He masturbates on Natsuki wherever he goes, even on school grounds. As he was thinking about Natsuki again today, he heard a noise. He peeked in that direction and found Natsuki masturbating. Nitta was transfixed by her. By chance, Natsuki found him. Seeing that she was about to cry after being seen in an embarrassing situation, Nitta confessed that he had been masturbating just a moment ago.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

anime.description:
Episode 1

Katatsumuri
A track-and-field girl waits for the bus alone at a bus stop in the middle of nowhere where it rains frequently. Then a climate otaku boy appeared. The two are soaking wet and talking as comfortably as if they were taking a break. While their abnormal sexual tendencies come and go, they respond to the otaku boy's desires and accept each other's desires. Under the sky after the rain, the men and women's feelings were different, but their satisfaction levels overlapped, and there were two people who were lost in thought.

Episode 2

Ame no Yo ni
On a rainy night when a middle aged man was desperate, a woman at a girls' bar named Aine approached him and he entered the bar, and then he started going to the bar several times. About a month later, he met a drunken Aine at a standing bar in the daytime. When he asked her about it, she told him that she was unemployed. After listening to her complaints for a long time and caring for her, they were alone together in a park restroom.

Natsu
The school pool was covered with the summer sun. As a boy is cleaning it, a female student, the class president, comes to help him. When they are almost finished, the girl slips and gets drenched in the pool water. He took her hand and helped her up. She says she has something she wants to try... and the two spend a summer of youth.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

titles.romaji: Bubble de House de ***: Ofuro Maker no Showroom ga Sharehouse de... The Animation

descriptions.default:
Based on the erotic game by Atelier Kaguya Honky-Tonk Pumpkin.

The protagonist, a student, moves into a share house that offers discounted rent in exchange for monitoring a famous bath manufacturer's products. He had thought he didn't get the opportunity, but to his surprise, he's accepted at the last minute. After moving in, he realizes that all the other residents are female upperclassmen from the same school. It's time for some heart-pounding, bath-filled, crazy student life with those ladies!

title.romaji: Imaizumin-chi wa Douyara Gal no Tamariba ni Natteru Rashii
title.english: Imaizumi's house seems to be a gathering place for gals
title.native: 今泉ん家はどうやらギャルの溜まり場になってるらしい

anime.description:
Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch’s potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch’s potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anime.description: One day, twelve amulets that protect the world are shattered. By whom? While the curse of shattered pieces is spreading to people around the world, for some reason there is only one person who is not under the curse. That is Rokuro. Rokuro sets on a journey with his big brother Goro and younger sister Nanako to save their family and eventually the world. With a magic brush that he got from a hermit, Rokuro's great adventure starts!

capable of providing a fun distraction for anyone who tracks it down.", "rating": 3, "userRating": "NO_VOTE", "score": 60, "body": "Let’s Make A Mug Too was one of the most pleasant surprises I stumbled into while watching seasonal anime in 2021. Learning tidbits about traditional Japanese pottery in a cute girls doing cute things styled format was a treat. It was one of the least watched shows of the season if sites like Anilist and MyAnimeList are to be believed which seemed like such a shame.

So after two seasons I was pleasantly surprised to see the show was getting a spinoff and was subsequently bemused to learn it was going to be about dental hygiene? Released exclusively on a Japanese dental hygiene app no less! The official announcement for the Rokuro The Great Adventure (aka Rokurou no Daiboken) suggested it would follow Rokuro as he “helps dentists and dental hygienists and works to prevent oral diseases and promote dietary education.” The show we actually got was nothing like that.

The show follows Rokuro, his older brother Goro, and his younger sister Nanako, as they travel across the land trying to find the shattered pieces of twelve amulets that protect the world. No one knows who shattered the amulets or why a curse seems to be spreading across the land, but Rokuro, with the help of his magic paintbrush and various “Help Gear,” will do his best to save the day!

Though you might not be able to get all those details without the help of the anime’s official website. The series just kind of throws you into its first episode with a very basic intro before the opening song plays and all of the cute little critters are off on their adventure. 

Rokuro The Great Adventure follows more of a monster of the week (technically of the month with how it released) format where Rokuro and the gang travel to a new area in the various weather based regions, encounter someone, and the evil character King curses them to become a big rampaging monster of some kind who must be stopped! Rokuro calls upon Dr. Tsukuro and the various Komonozuku who are with him make a tool to help them out. If and when that tool fails, Rokuro uses his magic paintbrush to paint something that will save the day. The curse is lifted, the people return to normal, and Rokuro usually eats a big tasty meal of some kind as thanks alongside his siblings. While the show is a bit formulaic, it does go out of its way to subvert its own formula in cute and comedic ways. It even almost breaks the fourth wall in goofy ways sometimes.

This show isn’t something like The Adventures of Timmy The Tooth or Dr. Rabbit in the Incredible Ride. In fact, minus a mouse holding a toothbrush that is hidden across episodes for kids to spot, there’s no actual mention of dental hygiene of any kind! All of that is done on the Dental E app which lets kids watch the episodes, play silly games, and read lots of instructions on dental care.

The show being exclusive to an app in another country and in another language is the big roadblock preventing English speaking audiences from watching it. While there is an English fansub online for those who know where to find it, is it worth going through the trouble to hunt it down?

I reasonably assume I’ll be the only person to ever consider reviewing this show in English, if at all. I hope if anyone comes across this review and likes to watch anime off the beaten path a shot. The show is only six episodes long, twelve really since they’re all split into two parts, and will run just over an hour for those watching the entire series. It’s not a lot of time to invest to see a cute little curiosity that very few other people will have on their watch lists.

But honestly, the novelty of Rokuro The Great Adventure being an anime exclusively released on a dental hygiene app is its greatest appeal. The proposition to sit down and watch it would probably be more attractive if it was more like the kitsch shows and films that overly focused on teeth that so many kids saw growing up in schools or at home. Rokuro The Great Adventure is absolutely a cute watchable little distraction but isn’t changing the world of anime by any means. 

So on the Grill Rating Scale™ I’d give it 3 out of 5 stars - Watchable. titles.native: ロクローの大ぼうけん

descriptions.default: One day, twelve amulets that protect the world are shattered. By whom? While the curse of shattered pieces is spreading to people around the world, for some reason there is only one person who is not under the curse. That is Rokuro. Rokuro sets on a journey with his big brother Goro and younger sister Nanako to save their family and eventually the world. With a magic brush that he got from a hermit, Rokuro's great adventure starts!

descriptions.default:
He becomes a kemonomimi boy in the new world after orgasming

A nameless 40-year-old single man loses consciousness from masturbating too much and thinks he has lived his life to the fullest, but when he regains consciousness he sees a cute girl with a worried look on her face in front of him. Her name is Misha, and she calls the man Norun. According to Misha, he had nearly drowned in the river. The man does not understand what is happening, but what he sees reflected in the water is the image of a cute boy with animal ears. The man is reincarnated into another world and becomes a person called Norun. The inhabitants of this world have animal ears and tails, there are more females than males, and it is a polygamous society. And Misha is the girl who will become Norun's first wife. Although they are not yet married, Misha lives with Norun, and does not hesitate to take off her clothes and take a bath with Norun. As Misha washes Norun's body, his crotch begins to swell more and more.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

titles.romaji: Iribitari Gal ni Manko Tsukawasete Morau Hanashi Animation

descriptions.default:
Hikari Kuroda, a classmate who often comes over to read manga to my house, the house of an inconspicuous "otaku" in class. The reason why Kuroda, who I thought I would never have anything to do with, started hanging out at an otaku's house three months ago was because she asked me if I had all the volumes of a very popular manga, and when I answered that I did... "I'm bored today, so I'll go read it." I don't find it annoying at all that she's started hanging out at my house. Because... She lets me use her pussy instead.

(Source: Fanza, translated and edited)

anime.description:
Lingwu Continent is a world where spiritual power and martial spirit coexist. A spiritual cultivator can move mountains and rivers with a thought, and a martial artist can tear the world apart with bare hands. Chen Tian, ​​a former genius in Xingchen Town, lost his martial spirit and dried up his spiritual sea after he turned ten.

Since then, he has become a waste of his family and has been looked down upon by others. In a life-and-death struggle, Chen Tian fell off a cliff and mistakenly entered the formation arranged by the ancient sword emperor. Under the influence of the power of the heavenly book, he awakened his spiritual and martial dual cultivation physique. At the same time, he also obtained a strange memory and a mysterious storage ring.

From then on, he rose from adversity, broke through the reincarnation of the Heavenly Dao Palm, and finally crossed the shackles of the emperor's calamity and aspired to become the champion of Lingwu Continent!

(Source: iQIYI)

anime.description:
Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn’s future shatters when he awakens the so-called “defective” Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the “weakest” class.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn’s future shatters when he awakens the so-called “defective” Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the “weakest” class.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

anime.description:
Sylpha, a guardian of the forest, fights and is defeated by a mysterious man who attacks an elven village and steals its treasure. Humiliated and with a lewd crest on her abdomen, her body is consumed by pleasure every day. She sets off on her own, determined to lift the crest while she can still retain her sanity and recover the village's treasure. However, Sylpha's body continues to be at the mercy of the pleasure of the crest.... What will be Sylpha's fate?

(Source: showten, translated)

descriptions.default:
Sylpha, a guardian of the forest, fights and is defeated by a mysterious man who attacks an elven village and steals its treasure. Humiliated and with a lewd crest on her abdomen, her body is consumed by pleasure every day. She sets off on her own, determined to lift the crest while she can still retain her sanity and recover the village's treasure. However, Sylpha's body continues to be at the mercy of the pleasure of the crest.... What will be Sylpha's fate?

(Source: showten, translated)

Oni Chichi Monogatari
Noboru Tenkawa was despairing of this world. In the deep forest where he finally arrives, he meets a woman of indescribable beauty. While admiring her figure, he slips off a cliff and faints. When he woke up, he was attacked by horned women who took turns attacking him. Overwhelmed by the use of their hips and crushed by their huge breasts, this world was a boob heaven! And when the village chief, Dakki, breastfed him, Noboru's crotch did not deflate, but remained erect! He's filled with happiness at the Nyuuson celebration.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

descriptions.default:
Oni Chichi Monogatari
Noboru Tenkawa was despairing of this world. In the deep forest where he finally arrives, he meets a woman of indescribable beauty. While admiring her figure, he slips off a cliff and faints. When he woke up, he was attacked by horned women who took turns attacking him. Overwhelmed by the use of their hips and crushed by their huge breasts, this world was a boob heaven! And when the village chief, Dakki, breastfed him, Noboru's crotch did not deflate, but remained erect! He's filled with happiness at the Nyuuson celebration.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

anime.description:
Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near!

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near!

anime.description:
Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time.

It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless!

(Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)

descriptions.default:
Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time.

It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless!

(Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)

anime.description:
Episode 1

Koisuru Kuroyagi
The owner of the mansion was a strict man and always gave a cold response. One night, Maya is seen by him shaving her hair. The owner had a peculiar sexual fetish and was sexually aroused by shaving women's pubic hair. Maya had been in love with him since she came to the mansion, so she pulled up the hem of her skirt to show her pubic hair and asked the owner, who couldn't hide his excitement, to shave her, and he readily agreed. She lathered up shaving soap and worked her way from her waist to her thighs, around her mucous membrane and down to her pubic hair. Maya was so moved by the sight of herself that she wanted to continue.

Futarikiri no Orca Show: Kono Koi ni Oborete
Lucca is performing in a spectacular aqua show. Recently, she has been losing focus and making mistakes. The reason is clear - she is in love with Masaki, who supports her. In order to reciprocate her feelings, the other members lie to the two and introduce them to each other in an empty venue. After confessing their feelings to each other, they make love to each other. Emotionally excited, the two fall into the pool, but ascend to heaven as their bodies sink.

Episode 2

Kyuusekkin!!: Koi wa Oshiire no Naka de
That day when he hid in the closet with his childhood friend... Puru fell in love. A few years later, he sees a woman talking intimately with his childhood friend and becomes so jealous that he misses school for several days. His childhood friend comes to visit him out of concern, but when he tells her what happened, it's all a misunderstanding on Puru's part. Time passes since the day his mouth was covered by tentacles in the closet, and he finally realizes that their feelings are mutual. The two fall in love and draw close to each other.

Kemono Michi
A boy wanders into an alleyway where it is rumored that a dog-like beast lives. When Moka opens the door, the boy stands frozen, his face stiffens, and he wets himself. She invites him into her house and takes a bath with him, and the boy's crotch becomes swollen, so she decides to treat it. Once, twice... and then he begs for more. Pleasurable things await him in the alleyway he has wandered into.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

descriptions.default:
Episode 1

Koisuru Kuroyagi
The owner of the mansion was a strict man and always gave a cold response. One night, Maya is seen by him shaving her hair. The owner had a peculiar sexual fetish and was sexually aroused by shaving women's pubic hair. Maya had been in love with him since she came to the mansion, so she pulled up the hem of her skirt to show her pubic hair and asked the owner, who couldn't hide his excitement, to shave her, and he readily agreed. She lathered up shaving soap and worked her way from her waist to her thighs, around her mucous membrane and down to her pubic hair. Maya was so moved by the sight of herself that she wanted to continue.

Futarikiri no Orca Show: Kono Koi ni Oborete
Lucca is performing in a spectacular aqua show. Recently, she has been losing focus and making mistakes. The reason is clear - she is in love with Masaki, who supports her. In order to reciprocate her feelings, the other members lie to the two and introduce them to each other in an empty venue. After confessing their feelings to each other, they make love to each other. Emotionally excited, the two fall into the pool, but ascend to heaven as their bodies sink.

Episode 2

Kyuusekkin!!: Koi wa Oshiire no Naka de
That day when he hid in the closet with his childhood friend... Puru fell in love. A few years later, he sees a woman talking intimately with his childhood friend and becomes so jealous that he misses school for several days. His childhood friend comes to visit him out of concern, but when he tells her what happened, it's all a misunderstanding on Puru's part. Time passes since the day his mouth was covered by tentacles in the closet, and he finally realizes that their feelings are mutual. The two fall in love and draw close to each other.

Kemono Michi
A boy wanders into an alleyway where it is rumored that a dog-like beast lives. When Moka opens the door, the boy stands frozen, his face stiffens, and he wets himself. She invites him into her house and takes a bath with him, and the boy's crotch becomes swollen, so she decides to treat it. Once, twice... and then he begs for more. Pleasurable things await him in the alleyway he has wandered into.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

anime.description:
Chaos ensues overnight when mysterious tombs suddenly surface, filled with divine relics granting overwhelming power, triggering a global power struggle to claim them for dominion. Among the havoc, a raider, Jooheon Suh, is betrayed and left for dead until a second chance brings him back years before the relics. Fueled by fury and future knowledge, he sets out to raid each tomb before they arise.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
Chaos ensues overnight when mysterious tombs suddenly surface, filled with divine relics granting overwhelming power, triggering a global power struggle to claim them for dominion. Among the havoc, a raider, Jooheon Suh, is betrayed and left for dead until a second chance brings him back years before the relics. Fueled by fury and future knowledge, he sets out to raid each tomb before they arise.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
Yuka spends her days in an uncomfortable classroom, eating lunch alone, and thinking only about the time she would sex stream at home. One day, she finds what appears to be a love letter in her shoe locker! When she opens it with high hopes, she finds a screenshot of her latest stream and a letter calling her... The man who called her uses the fact that her stream was exposed as a pretext to pressure her into sex streaming in front of him. Rather than being assaulted... she does as he says and does it until she climaxes, but the man assaults Yuka right after she has climaxed!?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

anime.description:
Arc returns! After waking to find he's become a Skeleton Knight in his favorite fantasy video game, Arc, Ariane, Chiyome, and Ponta band together to take on evil. Before Arc's search for a cure to his skeletal condition continues, he must face a dogmatic leader, Count Hilk, to free oppressed elves and beasts. A new chapter begins as the Skeleton Knight fights to make his new world a better place.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

descriptions.default:
Arc returns! After waking to find he's become a Skeleton Knight in his favorite fantasy video game, Arc, Ariane, Chiyome, and Ponta band together to take on evil. Before Arc's search for a cure to his skeletal condition continues, he must face a dogmatic leader, Count Hilk, to free oppressed elves and beasts. A new chapter begins as the Skeleton Knight fights to make his new world a better place.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

__Early Life & Education__ She was born in Tokyo on March 11, 1992. Her father had spent 9 years abroad and was fluent in English, which allowed her to develop fluency in the language. From an early age she had an interest in anime, in particular the series _Ojamajo Doremi_ and _Sailor Moon_. However, it was the anime series _Fullmetal Alchemist_ that was the first to inspire her to become a voice actress. At the time, she was impressed that the series' protagonist Edward Elric was voiced by a female actress, [Romi Park](https://anilist.co/staff/95082/Romi-Park). In junior high school and high school, she became part of a chorus club to help her overcome her tone deafness. It was also during this time she decided to pursue a voice acting career as she had interacted with schoolmates who had similar interests. Her parents approved of her decision, provided that she pass her university entrance exams. __Voice Acting Career__ While in high school, she began attending the Japan Narration Acting Institute. After 3 years of training, she passed her audition and joined the agency Arts Vision. At the same time, she also passed her entrance exam and began studying at Waseda University. She debuted as a voice actress in 2010 and later that year she played her first main role in the anime series _The World God Only Knows_. Throughout her 4 years in University, she continued to work as a voice actress, successfully managing both her work and school responsibilities. She graduated in March 2014 and left Art Vision shortly after on April 1. On May 1, 2014, she transferred to the agency Intention and is currently affiliated with them today. __Music Career__ Her music career began when she released songs for _The World God Only Knows_ under her character name Kanon Nakagawa. In 2013, she became part of the music group Rhodanthe*, which performed theme songs for the _Kiniro Mosaic_ series. After having been cast in 2015, she has also released singles as her Idolmaster character Mizuki Kawashima. In 2016, she voiced a member of the in-universe music group Walküre, which performed songs for the anime series _Macross Δ_. In 2017, she made her solo debut as a singer on February 1 with the release of her single "True Destiny" / "Chain the World" under the Flying Dog label. Later that year, her second single "Ima Koko" / "Tsuki ga Kirei" was released on May 24 as well as her first album _Rainbow_ on October 25. In 2018, she held her first solo live event at the Nippon Budokan on February 3 and released her third single "Tomoshibi no Manima ni" on May 30. In 2019, she released her second album _Gunjou Infinity_ on April 3. During the months of August and September, she held her first tour live event performing in the cities of Osaka, Nagoya, and Yokohama as well as cities outside of Japan like Taipei and Shanghai. In 2020, her fourth single "Aruite Ikou!" is set to release on February 5. __Non-Anime Roles:__ - Misono Mika in "Blue Archive" (VG) - Mualani in "Genshin Impact" (VG) - Juna Crawford - The Legend of Magical Girls - they're strong, cool and agile. Everyone wants to be one. Popular and high-paying, it's a respectable line of work. Kana Sakuragi, Hitomi Koshigaya, and the members of Magilumiere work to promote the Alice System, which allows Magical Girls to order the magic they need to battle. But behind the scenes, factions seeking to ease magic regulations and make a profit are moving...

(Source: Prime Video)

Fairouz was born to a Japanese mother and an Egyptian father. She was named after the Lebanese singer, Fairuz. She spent a few years of her elementary education in Cairo before returning to Japan. During her junior high school years, she became familiar with the manga series [JoJo's Bizarre Adventure](https://anilist.co/manga/31517/). Due to her growing interest in the series, she would join Skype reading sessions with other fans. Eventually, she was inspired to pursue a career in voice acting, but her parents initially disapproved of her plans. Instead, she would initially study at a graphic design vocational school before spending a year as a dental assistant. Magical Girls - they're strong, cool and agile. Everyone wants to be one. Popular and high-paying, it's a respectable line of work. Kana Sakuragi, Hitomi Koshigaya, and the members of Magilumiere work to promote the Alice System, which allows Magical Girls to order the magic they need to battle. But behind the scenes, factions seeking to ease magic regulations and make a profit are moving...

(Source: Prime Video)

anime.title_native: BLEACH 千年血戦篇-禍進譚-
anime.description:
Destruction looms at the end of the Thousand-Year Blood War between the Soul Reapers and Quincies… as the death of the Soul King mirrors the collapse of the Three Worlds, distortions and omens of destruction start to appear in all realms.

Fierce battles erupt throughout the Wahr Welt between the Thirteen Court Guard Squads and the Royal Guard. Ichigo learns about Uryuu's true intentions and renews his determination to protect the world together, as friends who trust each other. Yhwach has surpassed even his own ability, The Almighty...

The fierce battle for the survival of the Three Worlds approaches its end. Beyond the chaos of calamity, what lies in wait—despair or hope?

(Source: VIZ Media, edited)

He is often found with his gang, who all ride large boars. Ganju's boar is named Bonnie (affectionately referred to as Bonnie-chan). The omake sketch after episode 114 implies that Bonnie was accidentally cooked into a stew by Retsu Unohana during a friendly cookout including her, Ganju, and a few others from the 4th Division. Similar sketches have occurred in the series, but Bonnie is always shown alive and well by the next episode. Ganju possesses a deep hatred for shinigami, a hot temper, and a strong ego. Though he always acts tough, he has shown that he also has a softer side, easily being cowed by his older sister Kūkaku, and later develops an understanding to Ichigo Kurosaki with a relationship similar to Ichigo and Renji Abarai's. The fact that he is not particularly attractive is a running joke in the series, and rather than deny this fact he tends to talk around the subject, especially when Yumichika Ayasegawa makes note of it. Because of his brother's, Kaien Shiba, death at the hands of Rukia Kuchiki when he was still young, Ganju holds a grudge against all shinigami. This grudge is slow to dissipate even after he learns the truth of the incident. It is implied that after Kaien and his wife Miyako's death, the Shiba clan lost its status as one of the Noble Clans (which include the Kuchiki and Shihouin clans). There now remain only four Noble Clans, as the Shiba had been the fifth. Upon Ganju's introduction, he and Kūkaku are the only remaining members of the clan. Though Ganju is not a member of the shinigami forces, he is of the Shiba clan and can fight on a level above that of an average shinigami, but lower than that of the higher ranking seated officers. He has a zanpakutō which resembles a meat cleaver or a Chinese Dadao, though he never demonstrates the ability to use its initial release. Ganju's sword skills are limited, so he relies primarily on his arsenal of fireworks, his agility, and his earth magic. Ganju's earth magic doesn't seem to operate on the same principle as standard shinigami kidō.
